verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas evidence describes a browser-first engine (WebGL2/WebGPU) with cloud Editor, npm engine package, and web-component/React wrappers, but nothing in the pack documents native desktop or mobile app export pipelines or any console partner/porting program. 'Download Apps for Self-hosting' refers to self-hosting the web build, not native platform packaging, so the story's core claim (one project → desktop/mobile/console) is unevidenced.
